tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows leukocytosis, mild erythrocytopenia, and a markedly elevated platelet distribution width, while hemoglobin, hematocrit, and other red cell indices are within normal limits. These findings may indicate an acute or ongoing inflammatory or infectious process. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
